items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: I didn't play with them. ... I never did see them, yeah, but I often heard them play... I used to call one of the guitar players, Bud Scott, but his name was Frank Sheese.

ctx.x: Did they have any trombone in the band ever? No, no. We didn't have any. No piano then, either? No piano, no. No piano.

Or was there a clarinet at that time? Yeah. No clarinet. No clarinet either? No clarinet. Just a cornet, violin, two guitar, and a bass violin. Almost a string band, wasn't it? Two guitar, yeah, yeah, string band. We were petering at this fella, Joe Scott, you know, in Natchez. No. No, I don't think so. Old Buddy, Buddy, you? No, I don't believe. Buddy Scott, from Natchez, Mississippi. Buddy Scott? Yeah, Buddy Scott. Oh, Buddy Scott. Oh, Buddy Scott. Oh, sure. Yeah, Buddy Scott. Yeah, Buddy Scott. Yeah, I knew…
I didn't know he was from Natchez. Oh, yeah. Yeah, Natchez, Mississippi.
